# jobrunner

Small job runner with a pluggable retry policy.

## Retry policy

`run_job` keeps its public signature and accepts a `RetryConfig`, a sleeper,
and a job closure. `max_attempts` is the total number of calls, including the
first call. Only `RetryError::Transient` failures are retried; permanent
failures are returned immediately. Before each retry, the sleeper receives a
delay beginning at `base_delay_ms`, doubling after each failed attempt and
saturating at `max_delay_ms`.

The default configuration makes one attempt with no delay. `FakeSleeper` is
available for tests so retry delays can be asserted without waiting.
